listings.name: Crane's Nest
listings.current_description: Crane's Nest Guest House & Spa @ 313 is an upscale guesthouse in Waterkloof Ridge, Pretoria, offering luxury self-catering and B&B accommodation with a full-service spa, outdoor pool, restaurant and pool bar, fitness centre, and meeting facilities, near Menlyn Park Shopping Centre and Groenkloof Nature Reserve.

listings.name: CSIR International Convention Centre
listings.current_description: The CSIR International Convention Centre is a conference and events venue on the CSIR campus in Pretoria, offering auditoriums and meeting rooms accommodating 10 to 500-plus guests, along with catering, audiovisual and hybrid or live-streamed event services. It holds ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certification.

listings.name: Dalani Trip Planners
listings.current_description: Dalani Trip Planners is a Pretoria-based travel agency specialising in curated group trips to international destinations such as Egypt, Namibia, Vietnam, Bali and Brazil, offering flexible payment plans over 6 to 10 months, travel dress hire, and full trip management from booking through to return.

listings.name: Danté Personnel Recruitment - Pretoria
listings.current_description: Dante Personnel Recruitment, established in 1996, is a South African staffing agency offering permanent, contract, temporary, project, and international recruitment placements across industries including mining, medical, logistics, finance, legal, agriculture, construction, engineering, and manufacturing, with a branch at Tijger Valley Office Park in Silverlakes, Pretoria.

listings.name: Dartcom Fibre Solutions
listings.current_description: Dartcom Fibre Solutions manufactures fibre optic cables, including drop cables, micro cables, duct cables, and self-support cables, from a production facility in the Waltloo/Silverton area of Pretoria, with an annual manufacturing capacity exceeding 12,000km, and offers telecommunications infrastructure services through its subsidiary Gbitel.

listings.name: Delter
listings.current_description: Delter IT provides creditors management software for micro lending businesses, scaling from small single offices to large banking institutions, with pay system integration, credit bureau data management and credit checks, operating at over 2,000 sites across South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Swaziland and Lesotho.

listings.name: Deneys Zeederberg Attorneys
listings.current_description: Deneys Zeederberg Attorneys is a South African law firm established in 2020, based in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein, focused on dispute resolution and litigation including private and AFSA arbitrations, international arbitration, mediation, and court representation, alongside commercial legal advice and compliance guidance on POPIA and FICA.

listings.name: DIEP Consultants
listings.current_description: DIEP Consultants is a specialised engineering consulting firm based in Irene, Centurion, offering services such as asset integrity assessment, process optimisation, HAZOP/PHA facilitation, front-end engineering design (FEED) and detailed design to clients in the oil and gas, industrial, mining, water treatment and energy sectors.

listings.name: DIFOX CONSULTANTS
listings.current_description: DiFox Consultants is a Centurion-based technology consulting firm offering cloud and infrastructure migration across Azure, AWS and GCP, cybersecurity and compliance, data and analytics/BI, custom software and API development, and IT strategy and project delivery, serving clients in financial services, healthcare, retail and education.

listings.name: Digistics Centurion DC
listings.current_description: Digistics Centurion DC is a distribution centre operated by Digistics, a South African supply chain and logistics company with more than 24 years of experience providing contract logistics, warehousing, transport and distribution management services from a network of distribution centres across major South African cities.

listings.name: Digital Companion Collective (DCC)
listings.current_description: Digital Companion Collective (DCC) is a business consulting outfit that connects clients with a curated network of service providers, including software development, concept design, business consultation, and change management partners, acting as a single point of contact so clients can focus on running their business.

listings.name: DNDM ELECTRICAL
listings.current_description: A renewable-energy and electrical services company, trading as DNDM Energy, based in Kirkney, Pretoria, designing, supplying, installing and maintaining solar panel, inverter and battery storage systems from brands such as Victron, Fronius and Sungrow, alongside general electrical and generator work carried out by COC-certified electricians.

listings.name: ECM Group
listings.current_description: ECM Group (Pty) Ltd is a Level 1 B-BBEE business consulting firm based in Akasia, Pretoria, providing business solutions, systems consulting, and marketing and brand management services to SMMEs, the public sector and large corporates across sectors including mining, construction, transport, logistics, manufacturing and energy.

listings.name: Edge Fitness
listings.current_description: Edge Fitness operates a gym on Level 3 of Sunnypark Shopping Centre on Robert Sobukwe Street in Sunnyside, offering a training space for members of all fitness levels. Open Mon-Thu 05:00-20:30, Fri 05:00-19:30, Sat 07:00-16:00, Sun 08:00-13:00.

listings.name: Efficient Leaders (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Efficient Leaders (Pty) Ltd is a B-BBEE Level 1 professional services company based in Centurion, offering HR services (skills audits, WSP/ATR, recruitment, performance management), skills development and training funding support, IT infrastructure services and marketing/website development, aimed at community upliftment and job creation.

listings.name: FPD Business School
listings.current_description: FPD Business School is part of the Foundation for Professional Development, established in 1997 by the South African Medical Association and now the largest self-funding health-sector education provider in Africa; it offers business, health science, nursing and IT programmes via distance, contact and e-learning study.

listings.name: Global Composite Solutions
listings.current_description: Global Composite Solutions (GCS) is an aeronautical composite-manufacturing company at Wonderboom Airport, Doornpoort, designing, developing and manufacturing aircraft components and complete aircraft -- including the Slick 360 and 540 aerobatic aircraft -- from its own workshop, spray booth and curing facility, in operation since 2006.

listings.name: Kainos Garden
listings.current_description: Kainos Garden is a family-run nursery and landscaping business in Celtisdal that grew out of a pandemic-era passion for gardening into an in-house producer of concrete garden pots, ornaments and water features, offering full landscape design and installation alongside plants from its own on-site nursery.

listings.name: Kataluma Function Venue
listings.current_description: Kataluma Function Venue is a riverside country venue in Zwavelpoort at the foot of the Bronberg mountain range, offering conference facilities, braai areas and free Wi-Fi for functions and family gatherings, along with two guest rooms including a family room that sleeps up to four.

listings.name: Korteks Textiles Africa (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Korteks Textiles Africa, now trading as Zaydtex, has operated from Sunderland Ridge since 1997 and has grown into the largest vertically integrated inside-curtain textile producer in Africa, running weaving, knitting, embroidery, dyeing and finishing operations across a 19,000-square-metre facility that employs over 250 people.

listings.name: La Louise Venue
listings.current_description: La Louise Venue is a wedding and function venue in Hesteapark trading since 2006, offering a chapel, an outdoor ceremony area and a patio for functions, and hosting weddings, parties, conferences, graduations and year-end events for up to 300 wedding guests or 500 conference delegates.

listings.name: Ligit Security Solutions
listings.current_description: Ligit Security Solutions has operated in the security industry for more than nine years, providing armed response, guarding, crowd control and event security services, including guards equipped with panic buttons linked to a control room, and drone-based security solutions offered in partnership with RPAS Consulting.

listings.name: Manaka A Amasenya Holdings
listings.current_description: Manaka A Amasenya Holdings is a Safety, Health and Environment (SHE) consultancy with over 15 years of experience serving the construction and manufacturing sectors, providing health and safety files, compliance audits, environmental management and onsite safety officers to help contractors meet health and safety legislation.

listings.name: Matrix Design Africa
listings.current_description: Matrix Design Africa is a Wapadrand-based software company with over 40 years in business, developing solutions including the DeltaERP business management platform, the ppe2go personal protective equipment management system, and safety technologies such as the IntelliZone proximity detection system and OmniPro Vision AI monitoring platform.

listings.name: McDonald's Atteridgeville
listings.current_description: This McDonald's branch in Nkomo Village Shopping Centre serves a full breakfast menu including McMuffins and hash browns until 10:30am, alongside signature items like Big Macs and crispy chicken burgers, plus a McCafe corner for coffee and pastries in its spacious, air-conditioned dining area.

listings.name: MCS Office National
listings.current_description: MCS Office National supplies a full range of stationery, office equipment and business technology for offices, schools and homes, stocking trusted brands such as Pilot, Bantex and Parrot as part of the Office National group, Southern Africa's largest independently owned stationery and office supplies network.

listings.name: Moonstone Business School of Excellence (Brooklyn Forum Building)
listings.current_description: Moonstone Business School of Excellence, based in Brooklyn, Pretoria, is a FAIS-accredited education and training provider established in 2015, offering wealth management, insurance and financial management, compliance officer and cybersecurity courses, accredited by DHET, SAQA, CHE, INSETA, FPI and FSCA, with flexible distance learning options.

listings.name: MTD Data Analysis
listings.current_description: MTD Data Analysis is run by a team of statisticians, economists, econometricians and informaticists who provide data analysis, statistical modelling and research support to businesses, academic institutions and NGOs, typically handling over 100 client projects a year with turnaround times of three to eight days.

listings.name: N.R Voyiatzakis Attorneys
listings.current_description: N.R Voyiatzakis Attorneys, founded in 2010, is a Pretoria North law firm specialising in general litigation, family law, personal injury law and criminal law, situated near the Pretoria North Magistrate's Court and accepting correspondent instructions for the Pretoria High Court and surrounding magistrate's courts.

listings.name: NJR Steel Pretoria East
listings.current_description: NJR Steel Pretoria East is a steel and hardware merchant in Samcor Park, tracing back to the original 'Northern Steel and Pipe' branch that first opened on this site, stocking structural steel sections, sheet and plate, tubing, expanded metal, grating, walkway mesh and roofing products.

listings.name: Office Group
listings.current_description: Office Group is an office furniture showroom in Bronberrik, Centurion, supplying desks, chairs and filing cabinets to executive offices, call centres, hospitals and home offices, with delivery and assembly available and nationwide distribution from head offices in Johannesburg and a distribution centre in Cape Town.

listings.name: Omnigo (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Omnigo (Pty) Ltd is a Waltloo-based electronic contract manufacturer founded in 1999, now part of Reutech within the Reunert Group, running a 4500m2 ISO-accredited facility with about 200 employees serving mainly the military market. Its capabilities include wire harness manufacturing, surface-mount technology and mechanical integration.

listings.name: Pioneer Plastics (Pty) Ltd.
listings.current_description: Pioneer Plastics (Pty) Ltd has manufactured industrial plastic products since 1982, producing stacking and nesting bins, pallet bins, drums, and tanks ranging from 25 to 5000 litres from its Rosslyn base, and has won the ARMSA product of the year award for eight consecutive years.

listings.name: Pionier Open-air Museum
listings.current_description: Pionier Open-air Museum is a living history museum set on a restored 3-hectare Victorian settler farmstead in Silverton, operated by Ditsong Museums of South Africa, with guides in period dress demonstrating bread baking, candle making, milking, and coffee roasting as 19th-century pioneers would have done.

listings.name: Power Plant Electrical Technologies (Pty) Ltd - Gauteng
listings.current_description: Power Plant Electrical Technologies (Pty) Ltd is an electrical engineering company operating since 1998, providing general electrical and instrumentation engineering and installation work from its Silverton branch, with specialties including load flow studies, electrical protection grading, earthing system design, and low- and medium-voltage switchgear work.

listings.name: Protech Batteries Pretoria North (Solite)
listings.current_description: Protech Batteries Pretoria North (Solite), established in 2009 and operating from Wolmer since 2011, supplies new and reconditioned batteries, including Solite-branded stock backed by a 30-month warranty, along with free fitting, testing, battery charging and the purchase of old batteries for cars, aircraft and boats.

listings.name: Recruitsmiths & AuthenticateDocs
listings.current_description: Recruitsmiths & AuthenticateDocs is a Pretoria-based document authentication service, handling apostille certification, certified translation, notary services, and authentication of academic, police clearance and civil certificates for clients in over 120 countries; the business began as a specialist IT recruitment agency before expanding into document authentication.

listings.name: Refurb Online
listings.current_description: Refurb Online sells certified, manufacturer-refurbished laptops, desktops, monitors, servers and mobile devices from brands such as Dell, HP and Lenovo, with graded stock, warranties of 12 to 24 months, fleet rental options and bulk ordering with VAT invoicing for corporate clients, delivered nationwide by courier.

listings.name: Roman's Pizza Atteridgeville
listings.current_description: Roman's Pizza Atteridgeville is a pizza and pasta takeaway restaurant in Atlyn Shopping Centre, Atteridgeville, offering a full menu of meat, vegetarian and BBQ chicken pizzas, its signature Triple-Decker pizza, pastas and sides, with dine-in, takeaway and delivery via Uber Eats and Mr D Food.

listings.name: SDE Telecomms (previously Linkworld)
listings.current_description: SDE Telecomms (previously Linkworld), trading as System Design Experts, supplies cellular signal boosters and repeaters, indoor and outdoor antennas and installation accessories, including vehicle booster kits and commercial systems for farms, lodges, mines and large buildings, compatible with MTN, Vodacom, Telkom and Cell C networks.

listings.name: Strat Training
listings.current_description: Strat Training is a workplace safety and skills-development training provider in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, offering over 120 accredited courses including first aid, firefighting, working at heights, dangerous goods handling, and equipment operation, with roots going back to a training company founded in 2007.

listings.name: TASEZ (Tshwane Automotive Special Economic Zone)
listings.current_description: TASEZ (Tshwane Automotive Special Economic Zone) is a government-backed industrial hub near The Willows, Pretoria, providing tenant accommodation, investment incentives and supplier-development support to automotive manufacturers, jointly held by the Department of Trade, Industry and Competition, the Gauteng provincial government and the City of Tshwane.

listings.name: Unique Dairy Products
listings.current_description: Unique Dairy Products is a Pretoria-based dairy manufacturer producing ice cream, soft serve, frozen novelties, milk, cream and yoghurt under its own Avondale, Creamstar and Milkworx brands, as well as contract manufacturing for other brands including Wakaberry, McDonald's and King Pie, from its Hermanstad facility.

listings.name: Vectorox (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Vectorox is an IT services provider in Pierre van Ryneveld Park offering business connectivity, telecoms, managed IT support, security systems, networking, hardware sales, print and document management, backup power and audio-visual solutions as a single-provider technology partner, founded in 2011 and serving over 500 businesses.

listings.name: Villarani Govender Attorneys Inc
listings.current_description: Villarani Govender Attorneys Inc is a Centurion law firm at Heuwelsig Office Park specialising in personal injury litigation, including road accident, municipal negligence and medical negligence claims, insurance subrogation recoveries, and mediation, with experience serving as a Contract Adjudicator for the National Financial Ombud Scheme.

listings.name: WDS Attorneys
listings.current_description: WDS Attorneys is a property law and conveyancing firm in Annlin operating since 1988, handling transfers of full title and sectional title properties, sectional title scheme registrations, bond registrations and cancellations, antenuptial contracts and deceased estate transfers, with additional offices in Midstream Estate and Hartbeespoort.

listings.name: Worldwide Automotive Group
listings.current_description: Worldwide Automotive Group is the distributor and franchisor behind the Goldwagen Group, an automotive replacement-parts network founded in 1992 that supplies original-equivalent parts for brands including Audi, BMW, Ford, Toyota and VW through around 100 franchised outlets, operating from its distribution warehouse in Louwlardia, Centurion.

listings.name: Accu-Prof Insurance Brokers
listings.current_description: Accu-Prof Insurance Brokers is an Authorised Financial Service Provider that has been providing short-term, commercial, liability and niche insurance solutions for 25 years, including professional indemnity, contractors all risk, commercial transport and niche products such as aviation, marine and drone cover, from its Elardus Park office.

listings.name: Apollo 21 Truck Parts - Gauteng(Pretoria)
listings.current_description: Apollo 21 Truck Parts is a truck, bus and trailer spare-parts supplier in Silvertondale, Pretoria, a DT Premium Partner offering OE-quality parts with a 24-month warranty, including Japanese gearbox parts for Toyota, Hino and Isuzu, with sister branches in Boksburg, Gqeberha, Polokwane and the Western Cape.

listings.name: Astron Energy Eloffsdal
listings.current_description: Astron Energy Eloffsdal is a fuel station on Paul Kruger Street, Eloffsdal, Pretoria, part of the Astron Energy network -- the brand that has been rebranding South Africa's former Caltex service stations since 2021, after Astron Energy took over the Caltex licence from Chevron in 2018.
